rule_source: Forecast-Grounded Decision QA Section 1.5 engineering design rules
value_space: normalized PipeFormer forecast variables; replace proxy limits with real station and segment limits

category_details.pressure: Minimum and maximum pressure, violation nodes, violation duration, pressure margin, and recovery time.
category_details.flow: Flow-change magnitude, segment capacity, abnormal-flow segments, and supply-demand balance.
category_details.linepack: Linepack change rate, minimum linepack time, recovery capability, and warning status.
category_details.compressor: Compressor load, compression ratio, power, operating envelope, and regulation margin.
category_details.dispatch_priority: Pressure safety and supply assurance; compressor and equipment protection; linepack margin; flow stability; then energy and cost.
